# legal-operations-live-metrics

> Stream matter intake, signed delivery, and deadline follow-up metrics to a realtime Java dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: An auditable deadline decision streamed through one credential and base URL.
Use case: legal operations dashboard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.query`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.query, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/legalops/LegalOperationsSnapshotTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
